hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block sight lines between pedestrians (especially children) and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce safety and security after dark.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: Multiple travel lanes in the same direction can lead to one vehicle stopping for a pedestrian while another in the adjacent lane does not.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add painted crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to manage vehicle speeds effectively on this long, straight stretch.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking or shoulder lane to shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Designate on-street parallel parking to act as a barrier between the sidewalk and moving traffic lanes.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add physical traffic calming to ensure vehicles maintain low speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to provide a designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk along the block to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implementing speed humps or cushions would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to manage vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical buffer, shade, and a vertical element that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Adding clear lane markings or a center line would help organize traffic and could be used to narrow perceived lane width.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island, to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.
